messages.content: Extract a governing concept at a transferable but source-bounded level. Return only JSON with governing_concept (string), odro (ontology, dynamics, regime, outcome strings), and limits (array of strings). Preserve conditions and avoid both overgeneralization and merely repeating the instance.

{"id":"counterfactual_commitment","input":{"source_text":"[s1] The River Party promised its ally a vote on the harbor bill. [s2] Later it gained enough seats to pass the bill alone. [s3] Its chair said the promise still governed the vote even though the ally’s seats were no longer necessary. [s4] The account establishes a stated commitment, not proof that the promise will be kept."},"track":"kce"}
